@graph.name: Test Workflow Trigger Success
@graph.description: Verify that a workflow can be triggered successfully with valid parameters
testSteps: Include authentication header with valid API key
@graph.expectedResult: 200 OK response with success:true, workflow triggered on GitHub, confirmation message returned
@graph.actualResult: 200 OK received, workflow triggered successfully, timestamp and repository info returned

@graph.name: Test Authentication Failure
@graph.description: Verify that requests without valid API key are rejected
@graph.expectedResult: 401 Unauthorized with error message about invalid API key
@graph.actualResult: 401 Unauthorized returned with appropriate error message

@graph.name: Test List Workflows
@graph.description: Verify that available workflows can be listed
testSteps: Include valid API key in header
@graph.expectedResult: 200 OK with array of workflows including name, path, and state
@graph.actualResult: 200 OK received with complete workflow list and metadata

@graph.name: Test Get Workflow Runs
@graph.description: Verify that workflow run history can be retrieved
@graph.expectedResult: 200 OK with array of recent runs including status, conclusion, and URLs
@graph.actualResult: 200 OK received with paginated list of workflow runs

@graph.name: Test API Response Time
@graph.description: Verify that API responds within acceptable time limits
testSteps: Measure response time for each request

@graph.name: Test Concurrent Requests
@graph.description: Verify system handles multiple concurrent requests
testSteps: All with valid parameters and authentication
@graph.expectedResult: All 10 requests succeed with no significant performance degradation
@graph.actualResult: All requests completed successfully, average response time: 1.5 seconds

@graph.name: Test Invalid Workflow ID
@graph.description: Verify appropriate error handling for invalid workflow
testSteps: Send POST request with invalid workflow_id: 'nonexistent.yml'
@graph.expectedResult: 500 error with message indicating workflow not found
@graph.actualResult: 500 error returned with clear error message about workflow not found

@graph.name: Test HTTPS Encryption
@graph.description: Verify all communication uses HTTPS via ngrok
testSteps: Verify ngrok URL uses HTTPS protocol
Attempt HTTP connection (should fail or redirect)
Check that sensitive data is encrypted in transit
@graph.expectedResult: All communication uses HTTPS, HTTP requests rejected or redirected
@graph.actualResult: ngrok provides HTTPS tunnel, all traffic encrypted

@graph.name: Test Health Check Endpoint
@graph.description: Verify health check endpoint returns service status
testSteps: Verify response includes status and timestamp
@graph.expectedResult: 200 OK with status:'ok', timestamp, and service name
@graph.actualResult: 200 OK received with all expected fields

@graph.name: Test ICA Natural Language Integration
@graph.description: Verify ICA can trigger workflows using natural language
testSteps: Verify ICA translates to API call
Verify ICA reports result to user
@graph.expectedResult: ICA successfully triggers workflow and reports confirmation
@graph.actualResult: ICA triggered workflow successfully, user received clear confirmation
